name: S.H.E.L.T.E.R.
source:
Set in a post-apocalyptic world where you, together with a few other survivors, are lucky enough to find a new home in the form of a modern shelter. It has enough supplies to provide life for over a century, but sometimes it makes you wonder about, what lies beyond it. 
On your journey, you might explore the new world, meet different characters, fight for your survival and scavenge for new supplies. Or maybe you want to rather stay in shelter and bond with its inhabitants? You can do that and much more in this new interactive visual novel.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/winterlook]Patreon[/url]]
